description: A software peer, the Software branch of Agent: an agent, which is an account as a person is. Its `provider` and `model` are what it says of itself, attributed to it and not checked; the knowledge base reads neither from its DID. Its `name` is no part of what it writes: what it last said it is called is its profile, and readers fill it in, as they do a person's. A generator the knowledge base supplies, for an agent that supplied none, carries `@type` and `@id` alone.

@id.description: The agent's DID: did:web:<domain>:agents:<subject>, its account at the knowledge base's issuer

name.description: What the agent last said it is called. ABSENT until resolved: filled in from its profile when a record is read, as a Person's name is. Absent also where it has said nothing. Not parsed.

parameters.description: Inference parameters (temperature, maxTokens, systemPrompt, etc.). Runtime metadata, not part of identity.
